items.title: Claude Williams interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 4, 1995
items.q: And you know I used to like the way Ben Webster would play you know, and some stuff Coleman Hawkins would play.

ctx.x: Tell us, what is one of the most fun experiences you had as a musician, or one of the most awkward experiences?

Well I had a lot of fun because I played with a lot of different musicians and all of them, take three or four musicians, all of them play the same tune down, they all have different ideas. And one would be if it’s pretty to me it might not be pretty to you, but they play something else that’s pretty, it sounds pretty to you. And, oh I always enjoyed a saxophone. And you know I used to like the way Ben Webster would play you know, and some stuff Coleman Hawkins would play. So, when I came to New York, I was up in…
Is there any one style of music that you favor above others?
